subject.title: Browser tool: 7 improvements from real-world automation field test

question: Which remaining browser-tool slice should maintainers sponsor first from this umbrella: state/readiness signals, model-facing batch/schema/docs, CDP element inspection, CAPTCHA signaling, or post-fill verification?
rationale: Current code already covers part of the report, while the remaining asks change browser API shape and agent state semantics rather than fixing one narrow broken contract.

options.title: Prioritize state/readiness signals
options.body: Split stale-ref, snapshot-readiness, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker, and action-result-diff signaling into focused browser contract work first.

options.title: Advertise batch first
options.body: Expose and document the existing lower-level batch executor as a model-facing browser act shape before taking on the broader state signals.

options.title: Close after partials
options.body: Treat selector support, selector waits, ARIA refs, and lower-level batch execution as enough and close the umbrella despite the remaining requested signals.

recommendation.title: Prioritize state/readiness signals
recommendation.body: Split stale-ref, snapshot-readiness, CAPTCHA/manual-blocker, and action-result-diff signaling into focused browser contract work first.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior partial fix and recently moved the browser implementation into the plugin boundary this work would touch.
